_comment: The emoji sets HumanityOS draws emoji with, in the order they are looked in: the first set holding an emoji draws it. The volunteer-drawn HumanityOS set (docs/outreach/volunteers-wanted.md, Emoji designers) goes AHEAD of OpenMoji here, so each adopted design replaces that one emoji only. After changing this file or a set's folder, run node scripts/gen-emoji-index.js. Layout and rules: scripts/lib/emoji-pack.js; design: docs/design/emoji.md.
